summary.en: Kogoro and Conan are brought to an apartment to examine the death of a man, Nobuo Yamamoto. Location: Apartment Room 306 Victim: Nobuo Yamamoto Cause of death: Gunshot wound in the mouth Suspects: Saburo Nakanishi The case is presumed to be a suicide as evidence project he puts a gun in his mouth and fires. His friend, Saburo Nakanishi, is suspected of murdering him as he left the crime scene without calling the police. When Kogoro is fed strawberries, Conan realizes who the murderer is.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。
